title: US charges three men over terror plots, including planned assault on UK airbase
paragraphs: Three men have been charged with plotting terror attacks on Jewish communities in Europe and the US, as well as an attack on the British military base RAF Fairford.
US officials have said they helped orchestrate a "campaign of terror" on behalf of organisations linked to Iran.
This new indictment comes after US planes were evacuated from another RAF base in the UK.
